lines.en: It's cold. I beat my wings slower than usual.
There are nicks along my yellow wing edges.
I fly along the sheltered side.

lines.zh: 草都干了，黄得跟我一样。
lines.en: The grass has dried yellow, like me.

lines.zh: 我不敢飞高，冷风在上面。
lines.en: I don't fly high. The cold wind is up there.
One flower's still open. I head over.

lines.zh: 翅膀一动，就有凉气钻进纹路。
lines.en: Each wingbeat sends cold through the veins.

lines.zh: 我在枯草里找剩下的花。
lines.en: I search the dry grass for what flowers remain.

lines.zh: 太阳出来那一会儿，我才敢动。
lines.en: I only move while the sun's out.

lines.zh: 我贴着地面飞，那里暖一点。
lines.en: I fly low; it's warmer down there.
The wind pushed me half a foot off course.
I go around that patch of shade.

lines.zh: 我飞得很省力，一点点挪。
lines.en: I fly frugally, moving little by little.

lines.zh: 从这片枯草，到那块石头。
lines.en: From this dry clump to that stone.

lines.zh: 翅膀上的鳞粉掉了一些。
lines.en: Some scales have come off my wings.
I settle on a leaf tip to warm my feet.

lines.zh: 我合着翅膀，躲在茎的背面。
lines.en: Wings shut, I hide behind a stem.

lines.zh: 平原的日光，晒暖了我才飞。
lines.en: Not until the plains sun warms me.

lines.zh: 冷的时候，我什么都不想做。
lines.en: In the cold I don't want to do anything.
My color is paler than other butterflies'.

lines.zh: 这片草地已经没什么花了。
lines.en: There's hardly a flower left in this meadow.

lines.zh: 我慢慢把翅膀张开一条缝。
lines.en: I open my wings a crack.
The wind keeps blowing. I don't move.
Not a single bee around.

lines.zh: 我在等一个暖一点的时候。
lines.en: I'm waiting for a warmer moment.
The dry grass is tall enough to break the wind.

lines.zh: 我数着云，怕它们遮住太阳。
lines.en: I count clouds, afraid they'll cover the sun.
My feet are stiff. I rub them together.

lines.zh: 你身上很暖，我飞近一点。
lines.en: You're warm. I come a little closer.
Don't block the sun.

lines.zh: 我落在你袖口上，借点热气。
lines.en: I land on your cuff for some warmth.

lines.zh: 这么大的影子，会让我更冷。
lines.en: A shadow that size will make me colder.

lines.zh: 你动一下，我这小身子就翻了。
lines.en: One movement from you and I'd tumble.
Are you looking for flowers too?

lines.zh: 我抬了抬翅膀，其实是在抖。
lines.en: I lift my wings. Really I'm shivering.
Don't breathe on me. The chill is too much.
I retreat to the other side of the stem.

lines.zh: 你的手很暖，可我不敢停太久。
lines.en: Your hand is warm, but I daren't stay long.
Cold air gets in through the tear.

lines.zh: 我的翅膀一边抬不高了。
lines.en: One wing won't lift as high now.

lines.zh: 我掉在干草上，声音很轻。
lines.en: I fall on the dry grass. Quietly.
I crawl slowly. Too cold.
I wasn't going to fly much longer anyway.
That made me colder still.
I curl up and wait for it to pass.
Scales gone. My wings feel thinner.
I'm alive. I can still beat my wings.

lines.zh: 太阳落山前，我得缓过来。
lines.en: I must recover before the sun sets.
This one's still open. Lucky.
I settle and sip slowly.
The nectar's cold, but still sweet.

lines.zh: 我得多吃点，撑过这一段。
lines.en: I need to eat well to last this stretch.
Hold it a little higher. I'm tired.
This flower's sheltered from the wind. Perfect.

lines.zh: 我绕着它，先看看有没有霜。
lines.en: I circle it first, checking for frost.

lines.zh: 暖起来的那一刻，我就来。
lines.en: I'll come the moment it warms.
Set the flower down, in the grass.
This sip will carry me a while.

lines.zh: 被碰一下，我的翅就折了。
lines.en: One touch and my wing folded.
In this cold my body is brittle.

lines.zh: 你踩过来的风把我推开。
lines.en: The air of your footstep shoved me aside.

lines.zh: 我撞在草茎上，掉了下去。
lines.en: I hit a stem and fell.

lines.zh: 擦到你的衣服，全是静电。
lines.en: Brushing your clothes, all static.
I hurry back onto a leaf.
Don't crowd. There's only one stem.

lines.zh: 我们撞上了，我又冷又晕。
lines.en: We collided. I'm cold and dizzy.
Your heel kicks up a line of dust.
I move aside. Slowly.
In this cold, and still this happens.

lines.zh: 你翅膀上的缺口，跟我一样。
lines.en: Your wings are nicked like mine.

lines.zh: 我们挤在一起，能暖一点。
lines.en: Pressed together, we're a little warmer.
Not much daylight left.
Follow me. It's out of the wind.

lines.zh: 卵要下在还没枯的叶子上。
lines.en: The eggs must go on a leaf not yet withered.
Let's fly slower.
After this season, there's nothing.
While you're here, I'm here.

lines.zh: 太阳偏了，我们落到草里。
lines.en: The sun's dropping. Let's go down into the grass.
Too cold. I daren't touch it.
I step on it and slide off.

lines.zh: 这东西暖一点，我靠过去。
lines.en: This one's warmer. I move closer.

lines.zh: 我搬不动，一点都搬不动。
lines.en: I can't move it. Not at all.
It reflects a cold light.
I test it with a leg.

lines.zh: 你掉的吧，我看着它落地。
lines.en: You dropped this. I watched it fall.
I rest on it. A bit warmer.
Something that big — I go around.
When the sun's out, I'll come back.
A flower in the distance. I see it.
Wind from that way. I'll go around.
I rise a little.

lines.zh: 这一点距离，也够我飞很久。
lines.en: Even that short way takes me a while.
A shadow is moving.
I'll stop first. No rushing.

lines.zh: 那东西的体温，我感觉得到。
lines.en: I can feel the warmth of it.
I'll head for the warm side.
I raise my antennae and scent the air.
That way. There's a flower.
I circle it slowly.
If it stays still, I'll come closer.
The cold wind keeps pushing me.
I'm looking for somewhere to land.
It's warm. I'd like to rest.
I hover, wings trembling.
A little further.
It doesn't seem to notice me.
A little more and I can land.
The wind dropped. I go now.

lines.zh: 翅膀冻得发脆，我还是撞上去。
lines.en: My wings are brittle with cold, but I still ram it.
In this cold, even hitting is hard.
I charge and fall off.

lines.zh: 我落在它眼睛旁边，算是挡他。
lines.en: I land by its eye — that counts as blocking.

lines.zh: 这一下不疼，可我尽力了。
lines.en: That didn't hurt, but I tried.
I grip its skin with my legs.
I circle it and confuse it.

lines.zh: 我扇动的风送了点凉气过去。
lines.en: My wingbeat sends a puff of cold air.
I'm off. It can't catch me.
I can fly once more.
I open my wings among the dry grass.
I emerged later than the others.
It's chilly. I keep still.
My wings aren't dry; the edges are soft.
There's little in flower here.

lines.zh: 太阳照到了，我试着扇一下。
lines.en: The sun's out. I try one beat.
I lift off, wobbling.
The wind is stronger than I thought.
I land on a stem to steady myself.
Heading for warmth.

lines.zh: 火一近，我翅上的凉气全没了。
lines.en: Fire neared and the chill left my wings.

lines.zh: 我从高处落下来，翻了几个身。
lines.en: I fell from a height, tumbling.
The water's freezing. One touch and I sink.
The blast smashed me into the grass roots.

lines.zh: 有个东西撕破了我的翅。
lines.en: Something tore my wing.

lines.zh: 光一过，我的翅膀硬了一下。
lines.en: The light passed and my wings went stiff.
No flowers. I grow lighter and lighter.
The thunder was so loud my wings locked.
There's no warmth here at all.
